metadata.description: Interface transport controls for the interFoam phase-fraction solver.
Number of phase-fraction correction passes per time step.
Number of phase-fraction sub-cycles within each time step.
Interface-compression strength used by the phase-fraction equation.
Number of limiter iterations for the phase-fraction equation.
Enable the MULES correction loop for phase-fraction transport.
Absolute residual at which the phase-fraction linear solver may stop.
Relative residual reduction for the phase-fraction linear solver.
User-selected OpenFOAM v2606 build configuration.
Select whether OpenFOAM uses system tools or compilers from its ThirdParty configuration.
Select the compiler family used to build OpenFOAM. Availability depends on the host platform.
Select double, single, or mixed scalar precision for the compiled OpenFOAM libraries and applications.
Select the bit width used for OpenFOAM integer labels, such as cell and face indices.
Select optimized, debug, or profiling compiler rules.
Select the MPI implementation used when compiling parallel OpenFOAM applications.
Enable or disable OpenMP compiler and linker flags.
Select the target architecture width where supported by the host compiler and operating system.
Shared solver start, stop, step, and write scheduling controls.
Select whether the case starts from its configured start time or the latest written time.
Starting value of the solver's native time coordinate. The solver determines its physical interpretation.
End value of the solver's native time coordinate; for steady solvers this can represent iteration time.
Select the condition that stops the solver.
Time-step value used by the native solver. Stability and physical meaning remain solver-specific.
Native write scheduling mode used by the selected tutorial.
Output interval; its meaning is selected by write_control (steps or solver-time units).
Number of correction passes in this solver-specific algorithm block.
Default finite-volume discretization choices shared by the selected tutorials.
Default time-derivative scheme from system/fvSchemes.
Default gradient reconstruction scheme from system/fvSchemes.
Default Laplacian scheme, including its surface-normal gradient treatment.
Default interpolation scheme from cell centers to faces.
Default surface-normal gradient scheme.
Default divergence scheme used by the selected OpenFOAM tutorial.
Fallback discretization for divergence terms without a more specific entry.
Solid mass density.
Poisson ratio of the isotropic elastic material.
Young's modulus of the isotropic elastic material.
Use the plane-stress constitutive formulation.
Explicit phase-flow divergence schemes used by the interFoam dam-break tutorial.
Divergence scheme for the density-weighted momentum flux.
Divergence scheme for transport of the phase fraction.
Divergence scheme for the phase-compression flux.
Linear solver stopping criteria from the solvers subdictionary in system/fvSolution.
Absolute residual at which the linear solver may stop.
Relative residual reduction required before the linear solver may stop.
Controls for retaining and formatting simulation output.
Number of recent time directories to retain; zero keeps all written times.
Representation used for written field data.
Significant digits used when writing scalar values.
Whether written output files are compressed.
Formatting mode for time-directory names.
Precision used when formatting time-directory names.
Whether the solver rereads supported dictionaries while running.
PIMPLE pressure-velocity coupling controls from system/fvSolution.
Number of outer PIMPLE iterations per time step.
Number of pressure corrections within each outer PIMPLE iteration.
Additional pressure corrections for non-orthogonal mesh faces.
Pressure-implicit split controls from system/fvSolution.
Number of pressure-velocity correction passes per time step.
Additional pressure corrections for non-orthogonal mesh faces.
SIMPLE steady-state pressure-correction controls from system/fvSolution.
Additional pressure corrections for non-orthogonal mesh faces.
Number of correction iterations in the stress-analysis solver.
Specific heat capacity of the solid.
Thermal conductivity of the solid.
Thermal diffusivity of the solid.
Include thermal stress in the solid displacement calculation.
